Resolves #20437

The Workstation feed ordering assertion now reads `sequence` and `items.0.id` in one synchronous App-worker request. A producer tick could previously land between its two awaited reads and fail a correct newest-first Store. All scroll, tick and equality assertions remain intact.

Evidence: L3 (real live-producer browser discrepancy and three complete repaired-spec runs) → L3 required (consistent observation without freezing the feed). No residuals.

Micro-review eligible: test observation only — one existing reader replaces two requests; the product invariant and runtime are unchanged.

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `WorkstationFeedKeepsScrollNL.spec.mjs` requests both values together through the synchronous `InstanceService#getInstanceProperties`. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: forced-batch live probe below; no producer pause, sleep or range assertion added. |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: three full local spec repetitions passed; the changed spec is selected by the Brain E2E workflow. Current-head CI remains the handoff gate. |

## Test Evidence

- Real Chromium/Neural Link probe at 2026-11-06 06:00 UTC: read sequence `25`, invoke the existing `appendBatch(5)`, then read first record `feed-00000030`. - Complete `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFeedKeepsScrollNL.spec.mjs`, explicit E2E config, `--repeat-each=3 --workers=1`: **3 passed, 31.7s** at 06:05 UTC. Uses an external Brain checkout and isolated Bridge/server ports; fixtures cleaned their owned processes afterward.
